examples.before: You get one free call and one written letter about your business. It costs you nothing, and you do not have to buy anything afterwards. There are 10 places, and they go in the order complete applications arrive. One company gets one place, no matter how many people work there. If you are on the waiting list, you are not promised a place yet.
